post1.quote: It doesn’t—but the myth sticks around.

post2.quote: swallowed gum doesn’t linger in your stomach for years

post3.quote: swallowing gum does not mean it stays in your stomach for seven years

paragraph.quote: It’s a memorable line, but it isn’t true.

raw.note_quote: I can’t present this claim as fact: swallowed gum does not stay in the stomach for seven years.
